features.name: Admin login
features.description: Admins can log in to the app using their credentials.

features.name: Add employee
features.description: Admins can add a new employee with their name, email, department, and job title.

features.name: View employees
features.description: Admins can view a list of all employees.

features.name: Edit employee
features.description: Admins can edit the details of an existing employee.

features.name: Delete employee
features.description: Admins can delete an existing employee.

constraints: The app must have a green gradient dashboard.
The app must be responsive and accessible on both desktop and mobile devices.
acceptance_criteria: Admins can log in and view the green gradient dashboard.
Admins can add a new employee and see it appear in the employee list.
Admins can view the details of an existing employee.
Admins can edit the details of an existing employee and save the changes.
Admins can delete an existing employee and confirm the deletion.
